cases.purpose: Independently check ordered default rows and verification when /etc disappears, explicit nested missing paths, and rejection of a non-directory parent.
cases.oracle: Python hashlib and stat construct complete independent manifest rows; literal verification report and status.
cases.comparison: Exact stdout, status and empty stderr; each candidate operation is checked and unexpected diagnostics fail the case.

files.oracle.py:
import hashlib, os
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('image')
rows = []
for rel in ('bash-os/two', 'bin/one', 'etc/bash-os/conf'):
    p = root / rel
    if not p.exists():
        continue
    s = p.stat()
    data = p.read_bytes()
    rows.append('\t'.join(['file', format(s.st_mode & 0o7777, 'o'), str(s.st_size),
        hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), hashlib.blake2b(data).hexdigest(),
        str(s.st_uid), str(s.st_gid), str(int(s.st_mtime)), str(int(s.st_ctime)), '-', '/' + rel]))
Path('expected').write_text(''.join(row + '\n' for row in rows))

cases.script:
set -e
export LC_ALL=C
umask 022
/usr/bin/mkdir -p image/bin image/bash-os image/etc/bash-os
printf 'one\n' > image/bin/one
printf 'two\n' > image/bash-os/two
printf 'conf\n' > image/etc/bash-os/conf
/usr/bin/python3 oracle.py
/usr/bin/cp expected manifest
integrity emit-manifest --no-header --root image > actual
/usr/bin/cmp expected actual
integrity verify manifest --root image > actual
[[ ! -s actual ]]
/usr/bin/rm -r image/etc
/usr/bin/python3 oracle.py
integrity emit-manifest --no-header --root image > actual
/usr/bin/cmp expected actual
integrity snapshot --no-header --root image -- > actual
/usr/bin/cmp expected actual
integrity emit-manifest --no-header --root image /absent/deeper > actual
[[ ! -s actual ]]
if integrity verify manifest --root image > actual; then exit 1; else rc=$?; fi
[[ $rc == 1 && $(< actual) == $'missing\t/etc/bash-os/conf' ]]
printf 'not a directory\n' > image/etc
if integrity emit-manifest --no-header --root image > actual 2> diagnostic; then exit 1; else rc=$?; fi
[[ $rc == 1 && -s diagnostic ]]
printf 'default roots and missing parent verified\n'
